description: This file defines the RowRenderer class responsible for rendering a table row into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for rendering row properties, padding, height, and cells, and manages external dependencies related to document object model and RTF writing.

classes.name: RowRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a Row object into RTF format, handling row formatting, cell rendering, and padding.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render a Row into RTF, including table row properties, cell borders, and content.

methods.name: RenderTopBottomPadding
methods.description: Renders the top and bottom padding for the row.

methods.name: RenderRowHeight
methods.description: Determines and renders the row height based on height rules.
